title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
description: Yuhi Yugure and Yasumi Utatane, high school classmates and co-hosts of a weekly radio program, paint a picture-perfect friendship for their listeners. Yet, in reality, they couldn’t be more different. Their off-air dynamic is a whirlwind of chaos and insults. As their tumultuous relationship unfolds, they navigate the turbulent waters of friendship and rivalry in the cutthroat realm of showbiz.

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: A new radio show starring the two high school voice actresses Utatane Yasumi and Yugure Yuhi, who coincidentally are in the same class, has started. The show is known for its cozy atmosphere, but Yasumi has a huge secret. Yasumi is actually a gyaru.

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: On today's High School Radio, Yuhi embarrasses herself by not knowing the butcher shop sells croquettes. Yumiko also lands a big role in an anime, and the main cast is getting together to sing the opening theme, but...

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Based on the conversation on the show, the two of them have a sleepover at Chika's fancy house. Yumiko's happy to see Chika enjoy the dinner she cooked. Then for some reason, they end up taking a bath together. How did it come to this?!

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Chika is MIA after rumors make the rounds that she was on the director's casting couch. Yugure's Knight bust into the class and begins to interrogate Chika on his live stream. When he almost reveals Yumiko's identity as well, Chika's anger explodes!

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Yumiko and Kagasaki go to Yuhi's agency to apologize. But there they find out that Yuhi could have continued as an idol VA even without Yumiko's intervention. When Yumiko says that she doesn't regret what she did, President Kashima scowls and...

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Chika and Yumiko are to do more promos as Heart Tart. But before their first guest appearance, they get some nasty comments from Mekuru. Even worse, Yumiko has to admit that she has a lot to learn to get to Mekuru's level of skill and knowledge.

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Chika's mother believes her work is putting her in danger, but Chika isn't ready to give up on her dream just yet. Chika's mother thus issues her a challenge that will make or break her voice acting career.

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: A few weeks after they won that bet, the outcry about Yuhi and Yasumi has died down. Both of them are also auditioning for roles in an upcoming anime, however when it's her turn, the director asks Yasumi to read a totally different role...

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: After an awful retake hell, Yasumi asks Kagasaki for help. They try figure out what Sugishita wants by recalling the audition. At school, Yasumi heeds Kagasaki's order to not overwork herself and joins the karaoke party and forces Chika to come too.

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Though the recording for Phantom is going well, Yumiko's not happy with her own acting. And now she has to participate in an event that pits her and Yuhi against Mekuru and Otome. The prize is enticing, but the first game is to confess your love?!

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Yumiko is down to her final recording session, and her performance still isn't living up to the directors' expectations. Can she search her soul and find a solution in the eleventh hour?

episodes_data.title: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Yumiko faces her final recording session, the biggest performance of her life, and her inner conflict all at the same time... with a little help from someone special.
